# Edmund Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-teens  <sub>[v5 c3 P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007), [v5 c3 P12](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0012)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v5 c3 P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls Harbour  <sub>[v5 c3 P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Miss Edmund  <sub>[v5 c12 P7](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0007)</sub>; Sissy  <sub>[v5 c12 P7](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0007)</sub>

## Appearance

Edmund is a handsome boy with well-shaped features, straight black hair, and large, expressive gray eyes. He is slender and tall for his age, with an appearance distinct from the rest of his family.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P12](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0012)_

## Personality

Sensitive, imaginative, and deeply poetic, Edmund is a dreamer who loves beauty, literature, and nature. Though quiet and averse to conflict, he possesses an inner courage and a strong sense of honor that drives him to defend others when necessary. He is thoughtful and observant, often processing his emotions and experiences through creative writing.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c3 P20](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0020), [v5 c12 P16](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0016), [v5 c12 P17](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0017)_

## Goals

- To become a published poet  <sub>[v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c24 P32](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0032)</sub>

## History

Edmund grew up in Hollowmere as the son of Dr. Hugh Carrow and Nell. He spent much of his childhood playing with his siblings and the manse children in Fern Hollow, where he frequently read poetry and shared imaginative stories with them. Although regarded by schoolmates as non-confrontational, he stood up to Dan Coyle when the latter insulted Grace Ashdown and his mother, successfully defeating Dan in a fight. Inspired by this victory over his fears, he subsequently agreed to go to the dentist to have a troublesome tooth extracted. As he grew older, he continued developing his talent for poetry, eventually earning praise for his written work.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002), [v5 c3 P1](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0001), [v5 c3 P12](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0012), [v5 c12 P7](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0007), [v5 c12 P15](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0015), [v5 c12 P17](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0017), [v5 c24 P32](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0032)_
